people.title.description: The title of the screen of the accounts the server suggests to follow, and of the place that opens it.

people.suggested.description: The title of the accounts the server suggests to follow, where they show on another screen (the search before anything is written).

people.home.defaultMessage: 你還沒有追蹤任何人。追蹤其他人，就能在首頁時間軸看到他們的貼文。
people.home.description: Over the accounts the server suggests to follow, on the home timeline while the reader follows no one (a new account).

people.failed.description: When the suggested accounts failed to load; Try again follows it.

people.empty.defaultMessage: 目前沒有可推薦的人。請改用名稱搜尋。
people.empty.description: In place of the suggested accounts when there are none.

people.more.description: The link under a few suggested accounts that opens the screen of all of them.

people.retry.description: The action that reads the suggestions again after they failed.
